Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
7:05 PM

National Museum, Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. It is already shut for today (Thu 12 Nov, 7:05 PM). Tomorrow, Fri 13 Nov, it opens at 10:00 AM.

Tickets: adults ₹20 foreign nationals ₹500 and students up to class 12 get in free with their ID card.

This is from the museum's own site. The page shows no update date, so the fee may have changed. The site also links to online booking at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum, which I have not opened.
